skillsbench-task-execution.name: skillsbench-task-execution
key_points: Docker path confusion: `solve.py` or `test_outputs.py` references `/root/scan_data.stl` — locally this is `environment/scan_data.stl`.

test_outputs.py hardcodes `/root/`: Running pytest directly on `tests/test_outputs.py` will fail with "file not found" or "permission denied" because `/root/` is the container path. You must either adapt the test or replicate its assertions with local paths.
Skill paths: In Docker, skills are at `/root/.claude/skills/<name>/scripts/`. Locally they're at `environment/skills/<name>/scripts/`.
Don't modify `instruction.md`, `solve.sh`, `task.toml`, or test files — only add your solution and output.
symlink requires sudo: Creating symlinks from `/root/` to local paths needs `sudo`, which may not be available. Prefer path adaptation over symlinking.

Physics model mismatch: If simulation results fail performance targets despite correct PID tuning, compare your simulation's physics model against `solution/solve.sh`. Adding "realism" (e.g. aerodynamic drag, friction, damping) that the oracle doesn't use will silently break rise time, steady-state error, and all downstream targets. The oracle's physics is the ground truth — match it exactly before tuning.
Missing report files: The verifier checks `acc_report.md` for exact keywords: 'design', 'tuning', 'result'. If the report file is absent or doesn't contain these words, the Report test fails.
Read `solution/solve.sh` to understand the oracle approach (allowed — never modify).
